summary: Resolution Minerals Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Australian annual report for the year ended June 30, 2026, lodged with the ASX and dated September 30, 2026. The report reviews operations, including completion of the Horse Heaven antimony-tungsten-gold-silver project acquisition in Idaho, Phase 1 and Phase 2 drill programs, gold discoveries at Golden Gate North and South, Antimony Ridge progress, and the Johnson Creek processing site purchase. No transaction terms, board recommendations, or advisors are stated. This is a routine periodic disclosure mapped to a US annual report equivalent, not a special situation; watch only for follow-on transactional announcements.
